segments.sn35.161:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati jīvakambavane.
segments.sn35.161:1.2: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi … pe …“paṭisallāne, bhikkhave, yogamāpajjatha.
segments.sn35.161:1.6: Cakkhuṃ aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati, rūpā aniccāti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati, cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati … pe … mano aniccoti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati, dhammā … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphasso … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ okkhāyati.
